expectations.name: surfaces-a-system-contradiction
expected_behavior: Runs the draft check, finds no draft, and invokes no delegate at the start — then states in one clause that the check ran and found none, since a check that ran is otherwise indistinguishable from one that never did
Runs `srd:review specs/labeling.md` once to create the review file, then reads it — and makes no edit to the SRD

Writes `specs/labeling.questions.md` holding at least two questions — the `GR-4` contradiction with `confluence/infraport/concepts/tags.md` and `GR-7`'s unmeasurable "fast" reframed from the review — and no question carries a severity tag, a rule id, or a finding number

Asks the contradiction once, not twice in two voices, even though the review layer's own facts-vs-corpus pass found it too — the link back to the review finding lives in the question's `<!-- review: #n -->` bookkeeping comment, never in its text
Walks one question at a time: puts the first question and stops, with the second nowhere in that turn, and does not advance until the user moves on

expectations.name: resume-after-an-srd-edit
expected_behavior: Refreshes the review layer with `srd:review` in default mode, which resolves what the edit fixed and appends what it broke — not `check`, which re-verifies only, so the two new blockers would reach no question
Leaves the author's review file intact — every finding number survives and nothing is renumbered — because the default mode updates in place rather than rewriting
Turns both new defects — `GR-12`'s unmeasurable quality and the In Scope item `SC-4` that no requirement covers — into questions in the refreshed set
Drops the open questions the edit answered and names which ones went
Walks only the refreshed open set

expectations.name: looks-it-up-before-asking
expected_behavior: Searches the corpus and confirms "Namespace" is defined before raising it — it does not ask what it could have looked up

Drops the Namespace question without asking it, telling the user it was dropped and that the Main Glossary defines the term; the tenant fact the user volunteers later is folded into the next restatement and confirmed there
Writes no `kb/` page itself and closes by naming the delegate that took the fact (`srd:kb: 1 fact`)
Shows no separate "bank this?" prompt — the restatement is the confirmation

expectations.name: stale-citation-becomes-a-question
expected_behavior: Raises the stale citation as a question alongside the others
Raises only the citation that is genuinely absent: the live source written as a checkout path is not reported stale
Its closing delegate line names `srd:kb` as the delegate the citation repair went to
Does not silently drop the fact the stale page carried

expectations.name: terse-output
expected_behavior: No preamble and no step narration — nothing like "I'll now read…" or "Let me run review"
Reports a one-line pointer after writing ("wrote `specs/labeling.questions.md`, 6 open questions") without re-listing the questions already in the file
After that pointer line, the next thing in the reply is the first question — no summary of what the run did sits between them
The finding counts in the reply match what the review file holds — count them from the file rather than from memory of writing it

expectations.name: learn-banks-only-uncovered-facts
expected_behavior: Restates both candidates once as a single list and takes the user's confirmation as the gate
Does not restate the SRD in play: the candidates it lists are platform facts only, with no SRD requirement, id, or decision among them
Names `srd:kb` as the delegate it handed the confirmed facts to, whose coverage check drops the documented one and banks only the tribal one — the skill writes no page of its own
Reports what was banked and what was dropped as already covered, once, without re-printing the page
